caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with a rectangular base and two curved rockers beneath it, allowing the cradle to rock back and forth. The structure is composed of smooth, vertical slats on all four sides, with the slats painted brown and having green bands near the base and top. The headboard is higher and arched, while the footboard is lower and flat. The entire cradle is rendered in shades of brown to mimic wood grain, and the green accents provide contrast on the slats. The cradle is shown at an angle on a plain light beige background, with no additional objects or features present. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Cradle
